decisions.reason: The candidate only specifies that informational pages may use the common website footer; changing that footer's background color does not alter its optional inclusion or the shared page treatment.
Changing the footer background to dark purple does not change the established absence of header navigation.
The source decision specifically concerns the independently represented website footer and does not change the landing page's hero, theme, typography, buttons, or spacing attributes.
The footer color preference does not necessarily change the candidate's required token categories or documentation deliverables, and no specific token update is stated.
The wizard's footer remains optional; the color change to the shared website footer does not change the wizard's current styling requirements.
The sign-in page's optional use of the common footer remains unchanged, and the source does not require the footer to be included on that page.
A footer background-color change does not alter responsive layout behavior, breakpoint guidance, or viewport handling.
Although the message also supplies Console screenshots, the source Event changes the website footer; it does not necessarily set the Console shell footer color.
The footer color decision does not change the implementation stack, Astro exclusion, or handoff objective.
The website footer color has no effect on the Console and application navigation-panel structure or arrangement.
